description: This file defines a C# class named Css which interacts with JavaScript through the IJSRuntime interface, providing methods to control the document body's overflow behavior.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A helper class to invoke JavaScript functions related to CSS styling, specifically manipulating the body's overflow property.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Invokes a JavaScript function to show the body's overflow (likely enabling scrolling).

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Invokes a JavaScript function to hide the body's overflow (likely disabling scrolling).
